name: decline-noun
description:
Each word of a phrase, taken as a noun in the nominative singular, put in the given case.

The word «диван» in the genitive is «дивана».

case: "nominative", "genitive", "dative", "accusative", "instrumental" or "prepositional".
number: "singular" or "plural" (12 forms in all; the nominative singular is the word itself).

Every word is taken as a noun; for a phrase of mixed words use decline. A word with a capital keeps it («Москва» → «Москвы»); an indeclinable word («кафе»), an abbreviation («МТС») and a word the tables lack stay. The accusative goes by animacy: an inanimate noun takes its nominative («диван» → «диван»), an animate one its genitive («кот» → «кота»), a singular in «-а» or «-я» the form of the tables («книга» → «книгу»). A hyphenated noun declines whole («диван-кровать» instrumental → «диваном-кроватью»).

Example: semkit read --text "диван" --text "кот" decline-noun genitive write -
-> дивана; кота

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.description: "singular" or "plural" (12 forms in all; the nominative singular is the word itself).
